name: MMT-Bench
intro: MMT-Bench 是大型视觉语言模型多任务能力基准，包含 31,325 道多模态多选题、32 个元任务和 162 个子任务，覆盖 13 种输入类型与 14 类能力。论文通过 OpenCompass 的三级答案抽取评测 32 个公开 LVLM，并以任务向量构建分层任务地图。
org: Shanghai AI Laboratory, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, The University of Hong Kong, The University of Adelaide, Zhejiang University
build_method: 多源数据, 规则生成, ChatGPT生成
modality: 图像, 文本, 视频, 点云
task_type: 多模态理解, 多任务评测
eval_feature: 多任务, 任务地图, 视觉识别定位推理规划
scale: 31,325个多选视觉问题, 32个元任务, 162个子任务
build_method_en: Multi-source data, rule generation, ChatGPT generation
intro_en: MMT-Bench evaluates large vision-language models across 31,325 multimodal multiple-choice questions, 32 meta-tasks, 162 subtasks, 13 input types, and 14 capability types. The paper evaluates 32 public LVLMs with OpenCompass three-stage answer extraction and builds a hierarchical task map from task vectors.

flowchart LR

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2404.16006 Sections 3-5 and the official project. The diagram preserves coauthor meta-task design, the three subtask-retention criteria, four dataset-discovery routes, 200-sample cap and source balancing, uniform metadata, manual-rule or ChatGPT MCQ generation with up to eight choices, 31,325/32/162 and 13-input/14-capability statistics, the corrected 32-model evaluation, three-stage answer extraction with Z fallback, hierarchical accuracy, and 162 LoRA-derived task vectors.
